title: Five dimensions: Depth, Time, Memory, Relationship, Practice
what: Depth (the inward axis) 'Nine avaraṇas as nine depths of consciousness. You move inward, not sideways. Each ring is its own world. You can rest at any depth.' Memory (accumulation) 'Every recognition leaves a luminous trace. Over months and years, the yantra becomes uniquely yours — bright where you have met her, mystery where you haven't.' Relationship (radial) 'Shaktis cluster around the people in your life. Ram is Ātmā's frequency. Ashrey is Nāma. Gaia is Ahaṅkāra. The work of recognition is inseparable from the work of love.'
